'''''Dude''''' is a 2025 Indian [[Tamil language|Tamil]]-language [[romantic comedy]] film written and directed by Keerthiswaran. Produced by [[Mythri Movie Makers]], the film stars [[Pradeep Ranganathan]], [[Mamitha Baiju]] and [[R. Sarathkumar]] in the lead, alongside [[Hridhu Haroon]], [[Rohini (actress)|Rohini]], Aishwarya Sharma. [[Neha Shetty]] appears in an extended cameo.

The film, Keerthiswaran's directorial debut and Mythri's second Tamil production, was confirmed by its streaming platform [[Netflix]] in January 2025, while Mythri officially announced the project the following March under the tentative title ''PR 04'', as it is Pradeep's fourth film as a lead actor. [[Principal photography]] commenced the same month in [[Chennai]]. The official title was revealed in May. The film has music composed by [[Sai Abhyankkar]], cinematography handled by [[Niketh Bommi]] and editing by Barath Vikraman.

''Dude'' was released in theaters worldwide on 17 October 2025, during the [[Diwali]] weekend. The film received mixed reviews from critics and became a commercial success.

== Plot ==
Agan and Kuralarasi alias Kural are close cousins who run Surprise Dude, an event-planning collective organising [[Party#Surprise party|surprise events]] for [[Weddings in India|weddings]], anniversaries, and [[Marriage proposal|proposals]]. Their playful friendship changes when Kural confesses her love for Agan. Startled, he rudely rejects her, insisting he sees her only as a friend and family member and will never develop romantic feelings for her. Hurt, Kural leaves for [[Bangalore]] to pursue higher studies. After a few days, Agan has an accident, realises he loves her, and decides to confess his feelings.

Seeking approval, Agan approaches Kural's father, Athiyamaan, a powerful minister, who immediately accepts and begins arranging the wedding without Kural's consent. When Kural returns from Bangalore, Agan eagerly visits her on the eve of the ceremony. However, when he forcefully tries to kiss her, she stops him and reveals that she is distressed and contemplating suicide by [[hanging]]. She confesses that she fell in love in Bangalore with Paari, her dim-witted classmate. Realising she no longer loves him, Agan conceals his feelings, passes the kiss off as a joke, and promises to reunite her with Paari. Kural later tells Athiyamaan that Paari belongs to another [[caste system in India|caste]]. He fiercely opposes the relationship and reveals that, to protect his political reputation, he previously killed his younger sister who was also named as Kuralarasi as [[Honor killings in India|she had a relationship with a man from a different caste]], concealing the crime for 32 years.

At the [[wedding reception]], Paari and Kural attempt to elope with Agan's help, but abandon the plan after seeing Athiyamaan's extensive political influence. Unable to flee abroad because Paari lacks an [[Indian passport|passport]], they fake the wedding, resulting in Kural marrying Agan. He subsequently helps the couple escape to [[Thailand]], but immigration requirements thwart their plans. They instead arrange to flee to Canada with help from Agan's ex-girlfriend and her husband. Paari's visa is approved, but Kural's is rejected after her medical report reveals she is pregnant with Paari's child.

Agan suggests [[Abortion in India|abortion]], but a gynaecologist warns that Kural's weak uterus could make the procedure dangerous and cause future miscarriages. Although Agan withdraws his suggestion, Kural insists on proceeding. He threatens to reveal the situation to Athiyamaan, forcing her to abandon the idea. She gives birth to a six-fingered baby boy, and Agan poses as the child's father to complete official paperwork and care for him.

Before Kural's rescheduled departure, Agan's friend reveals that he had always loved her but stepped aside after learning of her love for Paari. Deeply moved, Kural confronts Agan and promises to find him a wife. She files for [[Divorce in India|divorce]] and searches for matches through [[matrimonial website]]s and [[dating app]]s, but unsuccessfully. To fulfil his promise to send her abroad, Agan asks his colleague Samyuktha to pretend to be his girlfriend, allowing the travel arrangements to proceed.

Athiyamaan discovers the divorce and summons Kural. Agan takes responsibility, claiming he intends to [[Remarriage|remarry]]. Furious at the public humiliation, Athiyamaan assaults him and orders his men to kill him. Kural then confesses everything to her father, who takes her baby son to kill him. Agan pursues them, and Athiyamaan suffers a heart attack just as he is about to commit the murder.

Athiyamaan awakens in hospital and is told that his grandson crawled to the road and attracted a passer-by who rescued them. Agan urges him to value love over reputation and caste. Athiyamaan repents, apologises to his sister—Agan's mother—publicly confesses to the murder after 32 years, and is imprisoned. It is then revealed that Agan actually saved him and falsely credited the baby in order to change Athiyamaan's heart and gain his acceptance of Paari.

In the post-credits sequence, Agan's mother reveals that he and Samyuktha have genuinely fallen in love and that their marriage has been arranged. The film ends with Agan finding closure through love and Athiyamaan achieving redemption through truth.

Sai Abyankar shocked millions on his debut movie by reusing the track "Oorum Blood" several times throughout the movie in multiple variations, a first for the industry, so much so that he had to release it all in a separate tracklist called "Dude Side B".<ref>{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DPq0UVIEpYO/?stkn=NXgyZGRlNjE4YnJv |access-date=2026-09-15 |website=www.instagram.com}}</ref>

This phenomenon has now come to be known as the "iSai effect" which is when a Sai Abyankar song would get mixed or critical responses during its initial release, but weeks or days later people would begin to uncover the true intent the great iSai held during composition, this would then make the masses love the song. This effect was also seen in Karrupu, and subsequent Sai Abyankar singles. But Dude (2026)'s soundtrack is the first recorded instance of the effect.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/DaS1HCDtFCk/?stkn=M3ZmODZyajMxaHk= |access-date=2026-09-15 |website=www.instagram.com}}</ref>

== Release ==

=== Theatrical ===
''Dude'' was released theatrically on 17 October 2025, during [[Diwali]], and clashing with ''[[Bison Kaalamaadan]]'' and ''[[Diesel (2025 film)|Diesel]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 October 2025 |title=It's officially Dude vs LIK for Diwali; Pradeep Ranganathan to have two releases on the same day |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/tamil/news/2025/Oct/01/its-officially-dude-vs-lik-for-diwali-pradeep-ranganathan-to-have-two-releases-on-the-same-day |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251001130710/https://www.cinemaexpress.com/tamil/news/2025/Oct/01/its-officially-dude-vs-lik-for-diwali-pradeep-ranganathan-to-have-two-releases-on-the-same-day |archive-date=1 October 2025 |access-date=1 October 2025 |website=[[Cinema Express]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=28 August 2025 |title=Harish-starrer Diesel joins Deepavali race |url=https://www.dtnext.in/entertainment/cinema/harish-starrer-diesel-joins-deepavali-race-844746 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250907174300/https://www.dtnext.in/entertainment/cinema/harish-starrer-diesel-joins-deepavali-race-844746 |archive-date=7 September 2025 |access-date=9 September 2025 |website=[[DT Next]] |language=en}}</ref>

=== Distribution ===
Romeo Pictures initially acquired the rights for Tamil Nadu, but stepped out of the project due to unknown reasons. [[AGS Entertainment]] later acquired the theatrical rights, marking their third collaboration with Pradeep after ''[[Love Today (2022 film)|Love Today]]'' (2022) and ''[[Dragon (2025 film)|Dragon]]'' (2025).<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 July 2025  |author=ஸ்டார்க்கர் |title=பிரதீப் ரங்கநாதனின் 'டியூட்' படத்தில் கெஸ்ட் ரோலில் சிவகார்த்திகேயன்! |url=https://www.hindutamil.in/news/cinema/tamil-cinema/1370751-sivakarthikeyan-in-a-guest-role-in-pradeep-ranganathan-dude-movie.html |access-date=30 July 2025 |website=[[Hindu Tamil Thisai]] |language=ta}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2025 |title=பிரதீப் ரங்கநாதனின் "டியூட்" படத்தின் திரையரங்க வெளியீட்டு உரிமையை பெற்ற பிரபல நிறுவனம் |url=https://www.dailythanthi.com/cinema/cinemanews/a-famous-company-has-acquired-the-theatrical-release-rights-of-pradeep-ranganathans-film-dude-1182921 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251006010654/https://www.dailythanthi.com/cinema/cinemanews/a-famous-company-has-acquired-the-theatrical-release-rights-of-pradeep-ranganathans-film-dude-1182921 |archive-date=6 October 2025 |access-date=6 October 2025 |website=[[Dina Thanthi]] |language=ta}}</ref> The overseas distribution rights were bought by Prathyangira Cinemas.<ref>{{Cite tweet |number=1929193058740133958 |user=prathyangiraus |title=Vanakkam Nanba & Nanbis 😎Indha Deepavali... theatre-la oru most exploding entertainer cracker ready aa irukku 💥💥@PrathyangiraUS's Next one is #DUDE 🔥 |author=Prathyangira Cinemas |access-date=14 June 2025 |date=1 June 2025}}</ref> Malik Streams Corporation distributed the film in Malaysia.<ref>{{cite web | title=Dude | Movie Release, Showtimes & Trailer | url=https://www.cinema.com.my/movies/details.aspx?search=2025.20597.dude2025.40106 | access-date=8 December 2025 | archive-date=22 December 2025 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251222233854/https://www.cinema.com.my/movies/details.aspx?search=2025.20597.dude2025.40106 | url-status=live }}</ref> York Cinemas handled the film's distribution in Canada.<ref>{{Cite tweet |number=1978902124927869140 |user=yorkcinemas |title=🎬 Get ready for the Canada release of “Dude” 🇨🇦 |author=York Cinemas |date=17 October 2025 |access-date=8 September 2026}}</ref>

=== Home media ===
The post-theatrical streaming rights were reportedly acquired by [[Netflix]] for {{INRConvert|25|c}}<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 July 2025 |title=Netflix picks up Pradeep Ranganathan's Dude for a whopping number, details inside |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/tamil/news/2025/Jul/07/netflix-picks-up-pradeep-ranganathans-dude-for-a-whopping-number-details-inside |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250707204402/https://www.cinemaexpress.com/tamil/news/2025/Jul/07/netflix-picks-up-pradeep-ranganathans-dude-for-a-whopping-number-details-inside |archive-date=7 July 2025 |access-date=7 July 2025 |website=[[Cinema Express]] |language=en}}</ref> and satellite rights were purchased by [[Zee Tamil]] and [[Zee Thirai]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/entertainment/dude-ott-release-when-to-watch-pradeep-ranganathans-latest-film-on-netflix-11762545551176.html|title=Dude OTT release: When and where to watch Pradeep Ranganathan's latest film online|last=Biswas|first=Sneha|work=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]|date=8 November 2025|access-date=12 September 2026}}</ref> The film began streaming on Netflix from 14 November 2025.<ref>{{cite web |last=Singh |first=Kashvi Raj |date=10 November 2025 |access-date=10 November 2025 |title=Pradeep Ranganathan's Dude To Have Its OTT Premiere On THIS Date |url=https://www.news18.com/movies/tamil-cinema/pradeep-ranganathans-dude-to-have-its-ott-premiere-on-this-date-aa-ws-l-9697030.html |publisher=[[News18]] |archive-date=12 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251112065328/https://www.news18.com/movies/tamil-cinema/pradeep-ranganathans-dude-to-have-its-ott-premiere-on-this-date-aa-ws-l-9697030.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Reception ==
=== Critical response ===
''Dude'' received mixed reviews from critics.<ref>{{Cite news |title='Dude' box office collection day 1: Pradeep Ranganathan starrer outshines his previous hit 'Dragon' with strong opening, mints Rs 10 crore |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movies/box-office/dude-box-office-collection-day-1-pradeep-ranganathan-starrer-outshines-his-previous-hit-dragon-with-strong-opening-mints-rs-10-crore/articleshow/124651041.cms |access-date=2025-10-18 |work=[[The Times of India]] |archive-date=20 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251020013926/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movies/box-office/dude-box-office-collection-day-1-pradeep-ranganathan-starrer-outshines-his-previous-hit-dragon-with-strong-opening-mints-rs-10-crore/articleshow/124651041.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

Roopa Radhakrishnan of ''[[The Times of India]]'' gave 3/5 stars and wrote "''Dude'' is a confident debut film. Even though it may not get a lot of things right, the film makes you curious about what its director is going to make next."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dude Movie Review: A lively film that blends mass and meaning |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movie-reviews/dude/movie-review/124623356.cms |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=The Times of India |language=en |archive-date=29 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029032239/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movie-reviews/dude/movie-review/124623356.cms |url-status=live }}</ref> Janani K of ''[[India Today]]'' gave 3/5 stars and wrote "'''Dude''<nowiki/>' is a fun-filled film that works best when it embraces its absurdity rather than preach. It delivers exactly what it promises – a fun, eccentric romance with moments of genuine hilarity. "<ref>{{Cite web |last=K |first=Janani |date=2025-10-17 |title=Dude Review: Pradeep Ranganathan's eccentric charm keeps the fun rolling |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/reviews/story/dude-review-pradeep-ranganathan-eccentric-charm-keeps-the-fun-rolling-mamitha-baiju-sarathkumar-2804645-2025-10-17 |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=India Today |language=en |archive-date=29 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029030649/https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/reviews/story/dude-review-pradeep-ranganathan-eccentric-charm-keeps-the-fun-rolling-mamitha-baiju-sarathkumar-2804645-2025-10-17 |url-status=live }}</ref> Neeshita Nyayapati of ''[[Hindustan Times]]'' gave 3/5 stars and wrote "If you liked Pradeep’s previous films ''[[Love Today (2022 film)|Love Today]]'' (2022) and ''[[Dragon (2025 film)|Dragon]]'' (2025), or Mamitha’s ''[[Premalu]]'' (2024), it’s more than likely that you will like ''Dude''. [...] It doesn’t hurt that their chemistry crackles when they’re together on-screen. ''Dude'' might not top any of the previously mentioned work of these actors when it comes to the writing, but it’s definitely a good addition to their filmography."<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-17 |title=Dude movie review: Pradeep Ranganathan, Mamitha Baiju film explores old conflict with new solution |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/tamil-cinema/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathan-mamitha-baiju-film-explores-old-conflict-with-new-solution-101760690553444.html |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=Hindustan Times |language=en |archive-date=29 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029033701/https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/tamil-cinema/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathan-mamitha-baiju-film-explores-old-conflict-with-new-solution-101760690553444.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

Arjun Menon of ''[[The Indian Express]]'' gave 2.5/5 stars and wrote "Pradeep Ranganathan and Mamitha Baiju-starrer ''Dude'' is ultimately a one-time watch, a film that starts off with breezy fun but loses its charm in a meandering, uneven second half."<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-17 |title=Dude movie review: Pradeep Ranganathan and Mamitha Baiju save this uneven entertainer |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/movie-review/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathan-and-mamitha-baiju-save-this-uneven-entertainer-10311970/ |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=The Indian Express |language=en |archive-date=17 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251017141227/https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/movie-review/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathan-and-mamitha-baiju-save-this-uneven-entertainer-10311970/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Prashanth Vallavan of ''[[Cinema Express]]'' gave 2.5/5 stars and wrote "''Dude'' has a wacky infectious energy, and uses it to make hard-hitting commentary on social themes, but fails to leave a lasting impact."<ref>{{Cite web |last=Vallavan |first=Prashanth |date=2025-10-17 |title=Dude Movie Review: Heart in the right place, everything else misplaced |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/tamil/review/2025/Oct/17/dude-movie-review-heart-in-the-right-place-everything-else-misplaced |access-date=2025-10-19 |website=Cinema Express |language=en |archive-date=29 October 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029030538/https://www.cinemaexpress.com/tamil/review/2025/Oct/17/dude-movie-review-heart-in-the-right-place-everything-else-misplaced |url-status=live }}</ref> Anusha Sundar of ''[[OTT Play]]'' gave 2.5/5 stars and wrote "Pradeep Ranganathan and Mamitha Baiju's film, which undeniably falls under both romantic entertainer and [[Social film|social]] [[Drama (film and television)|drama]] categories, gets saved by some smart performances and onscreen execution. [...] With some evident flaws and noble intentions, ''Dude'' strives to be an entertainer which it achieves to an extent."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dude movie review: Pradeep Ranganathan-Mamitha Baiju film is fun and flawed |url=https://www.ottplay.com/review/dude-movie-review-pradeep-rangananthan-and-mamitha-baijus-eccentric-entertainer-is-fun-and-flawed/e89c760ff0672 |access-date=2025-10-19 |website=OTTPlay |language=en |last=Sundar |first=Anusha |date=2025-10-17 |archive-date=10 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251110143529/https://www.ottplay.com/review/dude-movie-review-pradeep-rangananthan-and-mamitha-baijus-eccentric-entertainer-is-fun-and-flawed/e89c760ff0672 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Srinivasa Ramanujam of ''[[The Hindu]]'' worte "While Pradeep scores not only in the humour part but also in the emotional sequences, Mamitha displays a range of expressions, especially when she is caught in a tug-of-war like situation during a wedding. [...] Where ''Dude'' misses out unlike Pradeep’s previous hit, ''Dragon'', directed by [[Ashwath Marimuthu]], or even ''Love Today'', is its writing of the characters other than the protagonists."<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ramanujam |first=Srinivasa |date=2025-10-17 |title='Dude' movie review: Pradeep Ranganathan's goofiness powers this Gen-Z love tale |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathans-goofiness-powers-this-gen-z-love-tale/article70174736.ece |access-date=2025-10-17 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X |archive-date=29 October 2025 |url-access=limited |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029030350/https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathans-goofiness-powers-this-gen-z-love-tale/article70174736.ece |url-status=live }}</ref>

Vishal Menon of ''[[The Hollywood Reporter India]]'' worte "Pradeep Ranganathan’s ''Dude'' wants to be a self-aware satire about love, ego and liberation, but its loud tone, chaotic twists and overcooked emotions leave you more exhausted than entertained."<ref>{{Cite web |last=Menon |first=Vishal |date=2025-10-17 |title='Dude' Movie Review: Pradeep Ranganathan Shouts Through a Loud, Crass Soup Boy Comedy |url=https://www.hollywoodreporterindia.com/reviews/theatrical/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathan-shouts-through-a-loud-crass-soup-boy-comedy |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251017085306/https://www.hollywoodreporterindia.com/reviews/theatrical/dude-movie-review-pradeep-ranganathan-shouts-through-a-loud-crass-soup-boy-comedy |archive-date=2025-10-17 |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter India]] |language=en}}</ref> Rajasekar S of ''[[The Federal]]'' worte "Overall, ''Dude'' is a spirited romantic drama that delivers ample laughs, heartfelt moments, and though-provoking commentary on caste and gender dynamics. Keerthiswaran’s directorial debut shows promise, blending humour and heart with a socially conscious lens, even if the execution falters in parts. For fans of Pradeep’s brand of quirky charm and those seeking a light-hearted yet meaningful cinematic experience, ''Dude'' is well worth a watch."<ref>{{Cite web |last=S |first=Rajasekar |date=2025-10-17 |title=Dude review: Sarathkumar steals the show in Pradeep Ranganathan starrer |url=https://thefederal.com/film-reviews/dude-review-sarathkumar-steals-show-pradeep-ranganathan-starrer-211896 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251017090008/https://thefederal.com/film-reviews/dude-review-sarathkumar-steals-show-pradeep-ranganathan-starrer-211896 |archive-date=2025-10-17 |access-date=2025-10-17 |website=[[The Federal]] |language=en}}</ref>

=== Box office ===
In India, ''Dude'' was released alongside ''[[Bison Kaalamaadan|Bison]]'' and ''[[Diesel (2025 film)|Diesel]]''. It opened to {{INRConvert|11|c}} domestically, with {{INRConvert|4|c}} from [[Telugu states]], becoming the highest opening among the releases.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-02 |title=பைசன், டியூட், டீசல் முதல்நாள் வசூல்... தீபாவளி வெற்றியாளர் யார்? |url=https://www.dinamani.com/cinema/cinema-news/2025/Oct/18/bison-dude-diesel-films-first-day-collection-details-who-is-the-winner |access-date=2025-10-18 |website=Dinamani |language=ta }}</ref> Worldwide, the film collected {{INRConvert|22|c}}, emerging as the highest opening for Pradeep.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-10-19 |title=box office collection day 2 - 'Dude' collected more on the second day than the first day {{!}} முதல் நாளை விட 2-வது நாளில் அதிகம் வசூலித்த 'டியூட்'...எவ்வளவு தெரியுமா? |url=https://www.dailythanthi.com/cinema/cinemanews/box-office-collection-day-2-dude-collected-more-on-the-second-day-than-the-first-day-1185649 |access-date=2025-10-19 |website=Daily Thanthi |language=ta |archive-date=22 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251122222327/https://www.dailythanthi.com/cinema/cinemanews/box-office-collection-day-2-dude-collected-more-on-the-second-day-than-the-first-day-1185649 |url-status=live }}</ref>

In [[Malaysia]], the film opened in second place on the Malaysian box office chart behind ''[[Tron: Ares]]''.<ref>{{cite web | title=Charts | Cinema Online | url=https://www.cinema.com.my/movies/charts.aspx?date=10/19/2025 | access-date=19 November 2025 | archive-date=12 December 2025 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251212052624/https://www.cinema.com.my/movies/charts.aspx?date=10%2F19%2F2025 | url-status=live }}</ref> In the following week (23 October 2025 – 26 October 2025) it climbed to No.1, overtaking Tron thanks to [[Diwali|Deepavali]] holiday.<ref>{{cite web | title=Charts | Cinema Online | url=https://www.cinema.com.my/movies/charts.aspx?date=10/26/2025 | access-date=19 November 2025 | archive-date=9 December 2025 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251209234657/https://www.cinema.com.my/movies/charts.aspx?date=10/26/2025 | url-status=live }}</ref>

It concluded its run with a worldwide gross estimated to be ₹100–113.25 crore.<ref name="bo1"/><ref name="bo2"/>

== Controversies ==
Musician [[Ilaiyaraaja]] sued Mythri Movie Makers for using his compositions "Karutha Machan" from ''[[Pudhu Nellu Pudhu Naathu]]'' (1991) and "Nooru Varusham" from ''[[Panakkaran]]'' (1990) without his permission. Mythri Movie Makers paid him {{INRConvert|50|l|year=2025}} as compensation.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-04 |title=Ilaiyaraaja allows use of his songs in 'Dude' after producer pays Rs 50 lakh |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2025/Dec/04/ilaiyaraaja-allows-use-of-his-songsin-dude-after-producer-pays-rs-50-lakh |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251223111936/https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2025/Dec/04/ilaiyaraaja-allows-use-of-his-songsin-dude-after-producer-pays-rs-50-lakh |archive-date=23 December 2025 |access-date=4 January 2026 |website=[[The New Indian Express]] |language=en}}</ref>

Director Keerthiswaran faced backlash on social media after replying to a fan on [[Instagram]] who questioned the film's vulgar dialogue. Some netizens criticized the director's response as rude, sparking debates online about his interaction with viewers. While certain messages were ignored by the director, playful or joking replies were also noted in other instances. The controversy gained attention during both the theatrical release and the film's OTT streaming period, contributing to discussions about the film's content and the filmmaker's conduct.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-11-23 |title=Keerthiswaran in trouble; 'Dude' director's rude reply to a fan sparks debate, netizens slam the debutant filmmaker |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movies/news/keerthiswaran-in-trouble-dude-directors-rude-reply-to-a-fan-sparks-debate-netizens-slam-the-debutant-filmmaker/articleshow/125517880.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20260331060333/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movies/news/keerthiswaran-in-trouble-dude-directors-rude-reply-to-a-fan-sparks-debate-netizens-slam-the-debutant-filmmaker/articleshow/125517880.cms |archive-date=31 March 2026 |work=[[The Times of India]] |language=en |access-date=12 February 2026 }}</ref>
